words: h1: Pricing
p: Inspyx is the home inspection app with a voice companion. Here's what the inspectors in our pilot pay.
span: Founding inspector
p: $69 a month
p: or $649 a year, and save $179
p: For the 10 inspectors in our pilot. Your price stays the same for as long as your plan continues.
a: Join the waitlist
h2: What your plan includes
li: The Inspyx app for iPhone.
li: Spex, the voice companion that takes your notes, photos and findings while you inspect.
li: Reports you send to your clients from your phone.
li: Your templates, agreements, clients and agents, kept in one place.
li: Help by email and phone.
h2: 30 days free
li: Your plan starts with 30 days free, once per inspector.
li: Your card is saved when you start. Your first charge comes on the day the free month ends, and the app shows that date.
li: We email you a reminder 7 days before the free month ends.
li: Cancel before then and you pay nothing.
h2: Faster reports, or three months free
li: Our promise is less time to a finished report.
li: It's measured against your own starting numbers: how long your reports take you today, written down with you when you start.
li: The clock starts when an inspection ends and stops when the finished report is ready to send. Your reports during your 30 free days are timed the same way.
li: If your reports don't take less time, you choose: three months free, or walk away.
li: The promise covers inspection businesses Inspyx sets up. We can only stand behind a setup we did and checked ourselves.
li: It isn't a promise of a certain number of minutes or a certain percentage.
li: To use it, write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919.
h2: How billing works
li: You start your plan in the Inspyx app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan.
li: Stripe, our payment processor, takes your card on its secure checkout page. That's where you choose monthly or yearly. Inspyx never sees or stores your card number.
li: Your plan renews automatically every month or every year until you cancel.
li: You get an emailed receipt for every payment.
li: Prices are in US dollars, and don't include sales tax where it applies.
h2: Cancel anytime
li: In the app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing, then Cancel subscription.
li: Your plan stays on until the end of the month or year you've paid for, then it stops. Nothing more is charged.
p: The details are in our cancellation and refund policy.
h2: Questions
p: Write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919.

words: h1: Cancellation and refunds
p: Last updated: November 9, 2026
h2: Cancel anytime
p: You can cancel your Inspyx plan at any time:
li: In the app: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing, then Cancel subscription.
li: Or write to support@inspyx.com, or call (888) 772-2919, and we'll cancel it for you.
h2: What happens when you cancel
li: In your free month: your plan ends when the free month does, and you're never charged.
li: After that: your plan stays on until the end of the month or year you've already paid for, then it stops. Nothing more is charged.
li: Changed your mind? Until that day, you can undo the cancellation in Manage billing.
li: Your inspections stay on your iPhone. Canceling doesn't remove them, and you can export them anytime: ☰ → Export.

li: Coming back: you can start a plan again whenever you like. The free month is once per inspector, and the founding price lasts only while a plan continues, so a new plan starts at the price we offer then.
h2: Refunds
p: When you cancel, we don't refund the rest of a month or year you've already paid for. These are the exceptions:

li: Deleting your account. If you delete your Inspyx account (☰ → Account → Delete your account), your plan ends at once, and we refund the unused whole days of the period you've paid for. The day you delete counts as used. There's nothing to refund in the free month, since nothing was charged.
li: Charges made by mistake. If you're charged twice, or charged after you canceled, we refund that charge in full.
li: Where the law requires a refund.
p: Refunds go back to the card that paid. Your bank usually shows them within 5 to 10 business days.
h2: If a payment doesn't go through
li: You'll get an email, and your card is tried again several times over the next two weeks.
li: You can update your card anytime: ☰ → Settings → Your plan → Update card.
li: If the payment still hasn't gone through after two weeks, your plan is canceled. You can start it again anytime.
h2: Questions about a charge
p: Please talk to us before disputing a charge with your bank. Write to support@inspyx.com or call (888) 772-2919, and we'll make it right.
footer: INSPYX LLC · Miami Gardens, FL support@inspyx.com · (888) 772-2919 AboutSupportPricingCancellation and refundsTermsPrivacy

words: h1: Terms of Service
p: Last updated: November 12, 2026
h2: 1. Who we are, and what these terms cover

p: Inspyx is made by INSPYX LLC, a Florida company in Miami Gardens, Florida ("Inspyx", "we", "us"). These terms cover the Inspyx app, Spex (its voice companion), the reports, templates and agreements you make with it, and our website. Together, they're "the service".
p: By creating an account or using the service, you agree to these terms and to our Privacy Policy. Questions: support@inspyx.com or (888) 772-2919.
h2: 2. Who can use Inspyx
li: Inspyx is for home inspectors and inspection companies in the United States. You must be at least 18.
li: If you use Inspyx for a company, you confirm that you may accept these terms for it.
li: Your account is for you alone. Keep your sign-in safe, and tell us at once if you think someone else has used it.
h2: 3. Your plan and payments
li: Price. Inspectors in our pilot pay the founding price: $69 a month or $649 a year. It stays the same for as long as your plan continues.

li: 30 days free. Your first plan starts with 30 days free, once per inspector. Your card is saved when you start, and it's first charged when the free month ends, unless you cancel before then. We email you a reminder 7 days before.
li: Renewal. Your plan renews automatically, every month or every year, until you cancel. By starting a plan, you authorize us to charge your card through Stripe each time it renews.
li: Payments are handled by Stripe. Your card goes to Stripe directly; we never see or store it.
li: Prices are in US dollars, and don't include sales tax where it applies.
li: Canceling. Cancel anytime in the app (☰ → Settings → Your plan → Manage billing). Your plan runs to the end of the period you've paid for. Refunds follow our cancellation and refund policy.
li: Failed payments. If a payment doesn't go through, your card is tried again over two weeks. If it still hasn't gone through, your plan is canceled.
li: Price changes. We'll tell you at least 30 days before any change to what you pay, and it applies from your next renewal. Your founding price doesn't change while your plan continues.
li: Extras. Anything you add to your plan later shows its price before you add it.
h2: 4. Your content belongs to you
li: You own your inspections, reports, photos, notes, templates, agreements, and your clients' and agents' details ("your content").
li: You allow us to store, process and send your content only to run the service for you, including through the service providers named in our Privacy Policy.
li: We never sell your content, use your clients' details to market to them, or use your content to advertise.
li: You can export your content at any time: ☰ → Export.
h2: 5. Your inspections and reports are your professional work
li: Inspyx is a tool. It doesn't inspect anything, and it doesn't give engineering, legal or other professional advice.

li: You decide what goes in your reports. Review everything before you send it, including what Spex records, files or suggests; labels and serial numbers read from photos; measurements and levels taken with the camera; and property facts, weather, Street View and images from above. Those come from public records and outside services, and they can be wrong or out of date.
li: Your agreement with your clients is between you and them. Make sure it meets your state's rules. Any sample agreement text in Inspyx is a starting point, not legal advice.

li: You confirm that you may collect, use and share your clients' and agents' details and photos. You follow the laws that apply to your work, including your license, your standards of practice and privacy laws.
h2: 6. Spex and other AI features
li: Spex uses artificial intelligence (Google's Gemini service, through our servers). It can mishear, and it can make mistakes.
li: Spex listens only while it's on, and you can turn it off at any time.
h2: 7. Using Inspyx fairly
p: Don't:
li: use the service for anything illegal, or to mislead or harm anyone;
li: share your account, or resell the service;
li: try to get into parts of the service, or other people's data, that aren't yours;
li: copy, take apart or reverse-engineer the app, except where the law allows it;
li: overload the service or interfere with it, including with automated tools;
li: use Spex to impersonate someone or to make harmful content.
p: We may suspend or close an account that breaks these rules. Where we reasonably can, we'll tell you first and give you a chance to fix it.
h2: 8. The pilot
li: Inspyx is new, and it changes often. During the pilot, features can change, be added or be removed. Something may break, and we'll fix it fast.
li: Your inspections are saved on your iPhone. Export them regularly, so a lost phone doesn't lose your work.
li: Inspyx measures your times (time on site, time to the report) on your phone. Sharing them with us is your choice. We name you or quote you only with your written OK.
li: You're welcome to send us ideas and problem reports. We may use them freely, with nothing owed.
h2: 9. Other companies' services

p: Inspyx works with services from other companies, including Apple, Google, Stripe, Supabase, Sentry, RentCast, the U.S. Census Bureau, the National Weather Service and NOAA. Their own terms may also apply to you. We aren't responsible for their services, and they can change.
h2: 10. Apple

p: The app is licensed to you, not sold. These terms are between you and Inspyx, not Apple, and Apple isn't responsible for the app or its support. Apple's standard license terms for apps also apply. Where they conflict with these terms, these terms govern, as far as Apple allows.
h2: 11. No guarantees

p: The service is provided "as is" and "as available". We work to keep it running, accurate and safe. We don't promise that it will always be available, free of errors, or right for a particular purpose. The app works on your phone without a connection; features that use our servers, such as Spex and property lookups, need one. The one promise we make on top of this is the faster-reports promise on our pricing page, on the conditions written there.
h2: 12. Limits on our responsibility
p: As far as the law allows:
li: Inspyx isn't responsible for indirect or consequential losses, such as lost profits, lost data, or claims about an inspection.
li: Inspyx's total responsibility for any claim is limited to the greater of what you paid us in the 12 months before the claim, or $100.
p: Some states don't allow some of these limits. Where they don't apply, our responsibility is limited as far as those states allow.
h2: 13. Claims about your work

p: If someone (a client, an agent or anyone else) makes a claim against Inspyx about your inspections or reports, your agreements with your clients, your content, or your breaking these terms, you'll cover Inspyx's reasonable costs of that claim, including legal fees.
h2: 14. Ending your account
li: You can stop using Inspyx and cancel your plan at any time. Canceling leaves your inspections on your iPhone.

li: You can delete your account in the app: ☰ → Account → Delete your account. That ends your plan at once, refunds the unused days you've paid for, and removes your records from our servers, as our Privacy Policy says. Inspections saved on your iPhone stay on it until you delete the app.
li: Sections 4 and 11 to 15 still apply after your account ends.
h2: 15. Changes, the law, and disputes

li: Changes. We'll post changes to these terms on this page. For a change that matters, we'll tell you in the app or by email at least 30 days before it takes effect. If you keep using Inspyx after that, you accept the change.
li: The law. These terms are governed by Florida law.

li: Disputes. Before going to court, write to support@inspyx.com, and we'll try to settle it within 30 days. Disputes go to the state or federal courts in Miami-Dade County, Florida. Either side may use small-claims court instead, where it qualifies.

words: h1: Privacy Policy
p: Last updated: November 12, 2026
h2: Who we are
p: Inspyx is made by INSPYX LLC, Miami Gardens, Florida. Questions about privacy: support@inspyx.com or (888) 772-2919.
h2: Who this covers
li: Home inspectors who use the Inspyx app or our website.
li: The people in their inspections (clients, real estate agents and others), whose details an inspector enters.

p: The inspector decides what to record about their clients and agents, and how to use it. Inspyx handles that information for the inspector, to provide the service. Inspectors own their client relationships, and we never sell anyone's data.
h2: What we collect, and why

li: Your account. Your name, email address and sign-in, handled by our sign-in provider, Supabase. We never see your password. You can add business details (your license number, logo, photo and signature), which print on your reports.

li: Your inspections. Property addresses and details; your clients' and agents' names, phone numbers and emails; findings, notes, answers and photos (photos can show the inside of a home); your client's signature on your agreement; and payments you record. These are saved on your iPhone. They leave it when you share or export them, or when a feature below sends what it needs to do its job.

li: Spex, the voice companion. While Spex is on, what you say, and any photo you show Spex, goes through our server to Google's Gemini service, so Spex can understand and answer. Our server keeps a usage record for each session (your account, how long it ran, and what it cost us), not the audio or the words. The captions stay on your phone. Spex listens only while it's on, and you can turn it off at any time.

li: Property lookups. When you choose an address, our server sends it to public-record, weather and map services to fill in the inspection: RentCast (property facts), the U.S. Census Bureau's address service, the National Weather Service, NOAA and the Aviation Weather Center (the weather when you start), and Google (Street View and the view from above). Address suggestions while you type come from Apple Maps, through your iPhone.

li: Crash reports. If the app breaks, a report of where and why goes to Sentry, our crash-reporting service. Names and inspection content are left out. You can turn this off: ☰ → Settings → Send crash reports.
li: Your plan. Billing runs through Stripe. Stripe receives your email address and card; we never see or store card numbers. We keep your plan's status, dates and price.
li: Your numbers. Inspyx works out how long each inspection took (time on site, time to the report) on your iPhone. Nothing leaves your phone unless you export it.

li: Our website and phone line. If you apply for the pilot on our website (the form is a Google form) or call our phone line, we keep your name, contact details and what you tell us, so we can answer you. If you join the waitlist on our website, we keep your email address, the two answers you tap, and which page and which ad or link brought you, so we can write to you when the pilot opens. Our phone line is answered by Mia, an AI receptionist, through a service called Retell. Our website uses no cookies and no ad trackers.
h2: What we never do
li: Sell anyone's data.
li: Use your clients' details to market to them.
li: Use your inspection data to advertise.
h2: Who we share with
li: The service providers named above, each only for its part.
li: People you choose to send things to, such as a report you share.
li: Anyone the law requires us to.
h2: How long we keep it
li: On your iPhone: until you delete it, or delete the app.

li: On our servers: while your account is open. When you delete your account, we remove your account and your records from our servers right away. We keep only what the law or our accounts require: Stripe's billing records, a record of any refund, and Spex usage records.
h2: Your choices
li: Turn crash reports off: ☰ → Settings → Send crash reports.
li: Turn Spex off at any time.
li: Export everything: ☰ → Export.
li: Delete your account in the app: ☰ → Account → Delete your account.
li: Ask us to see, correct or delete your information: support@inspyx.com.
p: If you're an inspector's client or agent, ask the inspector first; we'll help them answer.
h2: Security
li: Data on your iPhone is protected by the iPhone's own encryption.
li: Connections to our servers are encrypted.
li: Every change to an inspection is kept in a tamper-evident record, and a signed agreement keeps the exact text that was signed.
li: No system is perfectly secure. Tell us at once if you think someone else has used your account.
h2: Children
p: Inspyx is for professionals, and it isn't meant for children under 13. We don't knowingly collect their information.
h2: Changes
p: We'll post changes on this page, and tell you in the app when a change matters.
footer: INSPYX LLC · Miami Gardens, FL support@inspyx.com · (888) 772-2919 AboutSupportPricingCancellation and refundsTermsPrivacy
